entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: The white-blue guild that functions as Ravnica's official government and creates its laws.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane and city where the Azorius Senate is based.

entities.name: Azor I
entities.description: A sphinx lawmage who founded the Azorius Senate and authored the original Guildpact.

entities.name: Guildpact
entities.description: The pact authored by Azor I.

entities.name: Augustin IV
entities.description: A human lawmage and Grand Arbiter who was killed by an explosion during an attack by the spirit of Szadek.

entities.name: Szadek
entities.description: The Dimir guildmaster whose spirit attacked, killing Augustin IV.

entities.name: Leonos II
entities.description: Leader of the Sova Column who became Arbiter of the Azorius Senate after Augustin IV's death.

entities.name: Isperia
entities.description: A sphinx who reluctantly became Azorius guildmaster and fell victim to Vraska.

entities.name: Dovin Baan
entities.description: A planeswalker who replaced Isperia as Azorius guildmaster and later fled.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A planeswalker who killed Isperia and later led the Phyrexian invasion force against Ravnica.

entities.name: Lavinia
entities.description: Became acting Azorius guildleader after Dovin Baan fled.

entities.name: Uzana
entities.description: A vedalken lawmage who leads the Jelenn Column.

entities.name: Sarvis
entities.description: Hussar commander of the Lyev until Dovin Baan removed him from office.

entities.name: Jelenn Column
entities.description: The Azorius Column that makes the laws.

entities.name: Lyev Column
entities.description: The Azorius Column that enforces the laws.

entities.name: Sova Column
entities.description: The Azorius Column that judges law-breakers.

entities.name: Prahv
entities.description: The monolithic white marble seat of Azorius power, destroyed when the Parhelion collided with it.

entities.name: New Prahv
entities.description: The Azorius guild hall targeted by Realmbreaker during the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Parhelion
entities.description: The fortress-ship of the Boros angels.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The Phyrexian invasion of Ravnica led by Vraska.

entities.name: Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations
entities.description: Detective agency to which the Azorius outsource complicated cases.

events.summary: Prahv, seat of Azorius power, is destroyed when the Parhelion collides with it.
events.quote: In Dissension , Prahv was destroyed when the Parhelion , fortress-ship of the Boros angels, collided with it.

events.summary: Grand Arbiter Augustin IV is killed by an explosion during an attack by the spirit of Szadek.
events.quote: who was later killed by an explosion during an attack by the spirit of the-Dimir guildmaster Szadek

events.summary: Leonos II becomes Arbiter and Isperia reluctantly becomes Azorius guildmaster.
events.quote: Leonos II became the Arbiter of the Azorius Senate

events.summary: Isperia falls victim to Vraska and is replaced by Dovin Baan, who introduces spy thopters and precognitive arrests.
events.quote: Isperia fell victim to Vraska and was replaced by the planeswalker Dovin Baan .

events.summary: After the War of the Spark and Dovin Baan's flight, Lavinia becomes acting guildleader.
Vraska leads the Phyrexian invasion force against Ravnica, directing Realmbreaker at New Prahv and her old jail.
events.quote: first directing Realmbreaker toward the Azorius Senate's guild hall, New Prahv

events.summary: After the invasion, the Azorius are overwhelmed and outsource complicated cases to the Agency.
events.quote: the guild outsourced these cases to the Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations
